title: Single-prop prompt discipline scorer for Seedance scene coverage
purpose: Reusable linter that scores a Seedance prompt against four discipline checks derived from art_01M64VKZ36V70FHZ5PHSM9651S r2: named place, explicit single-prop (disc), no multi-prop language, anchor character. Returns a 0–4 score and per-check flags. Use before submitting a run to catch prompts that might drift the prop count or drop the location anchor.
